checked_claims.note: The lowest-weight restriction surjection is used over Q on the open stack only. No coarse-moduli comparison, integral assertion, diagonal-kernel description, or Schur-Weyl claim is needed.

The relevant universal-curve fibre power is smooth and proper over M_6. Smooth-proper Leray degeneration together with the stated Chow-Kunneth projectors gives an actual splitting of mixed Hodge structures, so no unexamined differential or associated-graded-only inference remains.
The non-homogeneity of omega_s is explicitly handled over Q. The proof may use the downward Kunneth-slot induction, so it does not depend on an invalid integral strengthening of Morita vanishing.
H^26(M_{6,5};Q)=0 follows from vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25. The proof does not incorrectly infer vanishing from degree 26 being the vcd of M_{6,6}.

For total Kunneth index at most 6, the base degree is at least 20, exceeding vcd(Mod_6)=19. Every remaining summand has a slot 2, and the downward induction, the vanishing of the slot-0 error through M_{6,5}, and the psi contribution have the stated degree shifts.
The primitive-quotient argument is optional and is scoped only to its vanishing claim. It is not used to infer Tate type.

The load-bearing type input applies to the open stack M_{6,5} at the inclusive bound n=5=c(6), with Q-coefficients. It supplies algebraicity of the pure-weight piece before Tate type is asserted and is an established theorem input rather than a predicted motive.

Pullback preserves the Q(-12) type and multiplication by psi contributes Q(-1), making the generated weight-26 terms Q(-13). Semisimplicity in the pure polarizable category upgrades the resulting subquotient to an actual direct sum, not merely a semisimplification statement.

For complex dimension 21, smooth-stack Poincare duality gives H^BM_16 congruent to H^26(21) with weights shifted from 26 to -16. The Tate twist is Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). The compactly supported Q(-8) corner is not substituted for this group.

No graph-stratum calculation occurs, so invariants versus coinvariants is inapplicable. The Casnati-Ekedahl/stable-pair route is not a dependency because the verified fibre-product peel already reaches the exact ordinary-cohomology group; omitting stable pairs therefore leaves no gap in this proof.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack is against CLM-0136-7: all preceding steps establish only containment in the psi-generated subspace, so every Hodge-type conclusion depends on W_24 H^24(M_{6,5};Q) being algebraic Tate exactly at the zero-slack boundary n=5=c(6). If the bound were strict, applied only to compactified moduli, or gave merely tautological Chow without algebraicity of pure-weight cohomology, the proof would fail. The attack does not refute the attempt because THM-0005 and packet-visible FND-0195 confirm the inclusive open-stack statement and the required algebraicity. The remaining degree, twist, Kunneth, semisimplicity, automorphism, and stable-pair attacks expose no unresolved dependency.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
